mechanism.claim: A same-direction standardized daily shock in both the two-year and ten-year US Treasury par yields is a broad duration repricing rather than an isolated curve-point move. During high BTC variation, rising yields tighten the discount-rate/liquidity environment and map short BTC, while falling yields map long BTC for the next day.
mechanism.side: opposite strict sign of the median standardized two-year and ten-year yield changes
mechanism.why_distinct: No existing repository candidate uses DGS2/DGS10 or the official Treasury 2y/10y daily par-yield pair. Treasury auction candidates use issuance-event demand, SOFR candidates use money-market dislocation, and FX candidates use currency returns. TPYSR is a continuous duration-factor transmission mechanism, not a repair or diagnostic control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the completed pre-entry BTC 24-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one sparse D+1 sovereign-duration shock clock is absent from Gross9 primitives.

features.source: official US Treasury Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates XML feed
features.observation: official 2-year and 10-year par yields for Treasury observation date D
features.availability: conservatively D+1 00:00 UTC; no same-date use
features.valid_transition: current and previous official observations both finite positive and separated by 1 to 5 calendar days
features.yield_changes: delta2=2y[D]-2y[previous], delta10=10y[D]-10y[previous], both strict nonzero with identical sign
features.standardization: each tenor change standardized independently against at most 90 strictly prior valid changes, minimum 60, current excluded, sample std positive
features.parallel_factor: cross-sectional median of the two standardized changes; strict nonzero
features.factor_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(parallel_factor) over at most 90 valid factors, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.70
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact completed hourly BTC log returns over [decision-24h,decision))
features.volatility_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 valid Treasury decisions, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.treasury: download and hash-bind official annual XML feeds for 2023-2026 only after this preregistration commit
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no tenor, rank, side, hold, availability, volatility, or subset repair.
